comparison.objective: Use a physical mouse to drag a file into the green on-screen folder; candidate mechanically adjusts and validates an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests maintaining a 0.6 N button press while making precise planar mouse motion and visually controlling a high-gain pointer. Candidate tests hex-key insertion, counterholding, collar rotation, locking torque, and iterative impact-response observation.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the file in the green folder, button released, mouse upright on its mat, and hands clear, with failures for wrong drops or mouse/monitor violations. Candidate requires two safe dynamic stops and retained collar setting.
comparison.reason: The objectives, manipulated mechanisms, and measured outcomes are unrelated beyond generic precision control. PR contains no adjustable mechanical energy absorber or retention test. Candidate lacks numeric rebound, overload, and drift thresholds, but those missing details do not imply overlap.
